reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'desktop') AS desktop_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'mobile') AS mobile_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'tablet') AS tablet_sessions
FROM sessions
WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives:
SELECT country_code, desktop AS desktop_sessions, mobile AS mobile_sessions, tablet AS tablet_sessions
FROM (
  -- one row per session of 2025
  SELECT country_code, device
  FROM sessions
  WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
) AS s
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR device IN ('desktop', 'mobile', 'tablet') GROUP BY country_code)

SELECT country_code,
  SUM(CASE WHEN device = 'desktop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS desktop_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN device = 'mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN device = 'tablet' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tablet_sessions
FROM sessions
WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY country_code

solver.query:
SELECT country_code,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'desktop') AS desktop_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'mobile') AS mobile_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'tablet') AS tablet_sessions
FROM sessions
WHERE (session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND (session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY country_code
